none: PAS FindID 972275: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), possibly irregular copy of a Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Chipped; this only arrived at after examination of processed images. Obverse description: head left. Obverse inscription: CONST [ANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description:Victory on prow advancing left with shield; torso appears vertically striped, arms horizontally striped, ?as armour. In exergue: Wavy line above a colon. Diameter: 13.5mm, Weight: 0.80gms, die axis: 9
